$Comment: The skeleton every Christmas contract inherits through Parent. It is never posted.
Season hides every contract built on it while Christmas is off; a child that writes its own Requires
keeps it, since Season is a leaf of its own. Listing files each one with the contracts. Rewards.Claim
is what every job on the Christmas Board pays, like every contract's: the pay waits at the board until
the player collects it. The board leaves with Christmas, and a job finished but not collected by then
shows Collect in the player's Objective Book instead, so its pay never waits a year for the board to
come back. The list is the board's pay table, a little favor on Santa's Nice List and a little
Festival Favor. A child that writes its own Rewards.Claim replaces the list whole. Each bucket inherits
on its own, so a list left in Rewards.Auto here would pay on top of every child's Claim. A child names
its board and band in Boards and its work in Objectives, and takes its words from the keys its id
